info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Analysis API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Analysis API enables users to perform comprehensive analyses of their banking portfolios to generate insights and optimize asset allocation. With this API, financial institutions and analysts can submit requests for portfolio analyses, allowing them to assess risk, performance, and liquidity of various financial instruments. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, risk management teams, and investment advisors looking to enhance decision-making processes. The API streamlines complex analytical operations and supports data-driven strategies in banking and finance.

post.summary: Create a new bank portfolio analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new analysis for bank portfolios within the treasury system. The request should include the necessary data for the analysis and will return a confirmation of the analysis creation along with its details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new bank portfolio analysis. It requires a JSON object that contains specific parameters for processing the analysis, ensuring that all necessary data is provided for accurate results.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested data.

CreateBankPortfolioAnalysisRequest.title: Bank Portfolio Analysis Request

portfolioId.description: The identifier for the portfolio being analyzed.

instrumentId.description: The identifier for the financial instrument involved in the analysis.

counterpartyId.description: The identifier for the counterparty involved in the transaction.

maturityDate.description: The date when the financial instrument matures.

CreateBankPortfolioAnalysisRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON structure for a request to analyze a bank portfolio. It includes details about the portfolio, instrument, counterparty, monetary information, and the context of the analysis request.

NotionalAmount.title: Notional Amount

amount.description: The monetary amount of the instrument.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is expressed.

NotionalAmount.description: This schema represents the notional amount of a financial instrument, specifying the amount and the currency in which it is denominated.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp for when the request was made.

sourceApplication.description: The application that initiated the request.

RequestContext.description: This schema provides the context for the analysis request, including identifiers for tracking and system source information.

Channel.description: This schema represents the channel through which the request was made, providing identifiers related to the channel type and device used.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument related to the portfolio.

counterpartyId.description: The unique identifier for the counterparty involved in the analysis.

CreateBankPortfolioAnalysisResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the portfolio analysis operation. It includes details about the portfolio, instruments involved, analysis status, findings, and metadata.
